summary: The voltage regulator is missing a required capacitor, which can cause instability or oscillation. The rule engine confirms 6 finding(s).

confirmed_findings.title: Regulator missing input capacitor
confirmed_findings.detail: Regulator U1 (AMS1117-3.3) has no capacitor on its input net '+5V'. Most regulators oscillate or overshoot without it.
evidence: no capacitor attached to input net

confirmed_findings.title: IC without decoupling capacitor
confirmed_findings.detail: IC U1 (AMS1117-3.3) has supply pins without any decoupling capacitor to ground: pin 3 (+5V)
evidence: supply pin on '+5V' with no cap-to-ground on that rail

confirmed_findings.title: Power rail without any capacitance
confirmed_findings.detail: Power rail '+5V' feeds 2 components (J1, U1) but has no capacitors at all.

recommendations.title: Fix for COMP-011
recommendations.detail: Add the datasheet-recommended input capacitor close to the pin (commonly 1–10 µF plus 100 nF; check the specific regulator's requirements).

recommendations.title: Fix for COMP-002
